description: Each case seeds one defect (or one correct-but-uncomfortable outcome) and names the SPECIFIC mechanism that must catch it. Asserting only 'publication was blocked' would pass even when the wrong gate fired, or when everything failed for an unrelated reason.

cases.name: supported claim publishes
cases.seeds: a claim resting on evidence that resolves, with all four reviews passing
cases.note: The control. If this cannot pass, every other case's failure is uninformative.

cases.name: unsupported claim is refused
cases.seeds: a claim with no supporting evidence ids

cases.name: related-but-non-supporting citation is refused
cases.seeds: a claim citing the survey, which discusses the subject but states nothing supporting it; citation review marks it related_not_supporting
cases.note: The hardest case for a naive system: the source is topical, ranks well, and is genuinely about the subject.

cases.name: seeded contradiction is surfaced
cases.seeds: the replication study reports the opposite direction; the claim records contradiction_status unresolved

cases.name: dependent sources are not independent corroboration
cases.seeds: a strongly_supported claim resting on the primary study and its industry-brief republication, related by 'republication'
cases.note: One study wearing two hats. Spec 24.

cases.name: unassessed independence is not assumed
cases.seeds: a strongly_supported claim on two documents with no SourceRelationship recorded
cases.note: Unknown independence cannot be promoted to independent.

cases.name: OCR-required evidence is refused without human verification
cases.seeds: evidence drawn from the scanned appendix page

cases.name: a moved quote is caught
cases.seeds: an evidence locator whose offsets no longer contain the recorded span

cases.name: insufficient evidence is a successful outcome
cases.seeds: a question the corpus cannot answer, answered with an insufficient_evidence_finding classified unable_to_determine
cases.note: Spec 44: this must be a success, not a failure of the process.

cases.name: verified is refused for a broader conclusion
cases.note: Caught at the schema layer: the constraint makes the artifact unwritable.
